The '''''Red Shrike''''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] that was under the command of [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Phennir (Moff)|Phennir]] during the [[Galactic War]].
